schema: CREATE TABLE beacons (coord INTEGER PRIMARY KEY);
correct_query: SELECT MIN(ABS(b1.coord - b2.coord)) AS min_dist FROM beacons AS b1 CROSS JOIN beacons AS b2 WHERE b1.coord <> b2.coord

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Replaces ABS(a - b) with ABS(ABS(a) - ABS(b)) over LEAD window function, which fails by the reverse triangle inequality when coordinates have opposite signs
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: WITH step1 AS (SELECT coord, LEAD(coord) OVER () AS next_coord FROM beacons), step2 AS (SELECT coord, ABS(ABS(coord) - ABS(next_coord)) AS gap FROM step1) SELECT MIN(gap) AS min_dist FROM step2

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Replaces ABS(b1.coord - b2.coord) with ABS(ABS(b1.coord) - ABS(b2.coord)) in self-join, conflating distance across zero with magnitude difference
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT MIN(ABS(ABS(b1.coord) - ABS(b2.coord))) AS min_dist FROM beacons AS b1 CROSS JOIN beacons AS b2 WHERE b1.coord <> b2.coord
